packages.name: Nepal Himalayan Adventure
packages.description: Experience the majesty of the Himalayas in Nepal with temple visits in Kathmandu, lakeside serenity in Pokhara, and stunning mountain views. An affordable yet epic adventure.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan Airport. Transfer to hotel. Evening visit to Thamel market for shopping and local food.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Heritage Tour
itinerary.description: Visit Pashupatinath Temple, Boudhanath Stupa, Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple), and Kathmandu Durbar Square.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu to Pokhara
itinerary.description: Drive to Pokhara (6 hrs) or fly (25 min). Afternoon lakeside stroll at Phewa Lake. Boating at sunset.

itinerary.title: Pokhara Adventure Day
itinerary.description: Early morning Sarangkot sunrise with Annapurna range views. Visit Davis Falls, Gupteshwor Cave, and World Peace Pagoda.

itinerary.title: Pokhara at Leisure
itinerary.description: Day at leisure. Optional: paragliding, zip-line, or short trek to Australian Camp. Farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Drive/fly back to Kathmandu. Transfer to airport for departure.

packages.name: Vietnam Discovery
packages.description: From the emerald waters of Ha Long Bay to the lantern-lit streets of Hoi An, Vietnam captivates with its beauty, history, and incredible cuisine. An affordable yet unforgettable experience.
included: Ha Long Bay overnight cruise with meals

itinerary.title: Arrival in Hanoi
itinerary.description: Arrive at Noi Bai Airport. Transfer to hotel. Evening walking tour of Old Quarter and street food trail.

itinerary.title: Ha Long Bay Cruise
itinerary.description: Drive to Ha Long Bay. Board overnight cruise. Kayaking, cave visit, and sunset on deck. Dinner onboard.

itinerary.title: Ha Long to Hanoi
itinerary.description: Morning Tai Chi on sundeck. Continue cruising. Afternoon return to Hanoi. Water puppet show in evening.

itinerary.title: Fly to Ho Chi Minh City
itinerary.description: Fly to HCMC. Afternoon Cu Chi Tunnels tour. Evening at Bui Vien walking street.

itinerary.title: Mekong Delta
itinerary.description: Full day Mekong Delta tour - boat rides, floating markets, fruit orchards, and coconut candy workshop.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning War Remnants Museum and Ben Thanh Market. Transfer to airport for departure.

packages.name: Sri Lanka Cultural Tour
packages.description: Discover the Pearl of the Indian Ocean with ancient ruins, lush tea plantations, wildlife safaris, and golden beaches. Sri Lanka offers incredible diversity in a compact island.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Colombo
itinerary.description: Arrive at Bandaranaike Airport. Transfer to hotel. Evening Colombo city tour - Galle Face, Independence Square.

itinerary.title: Colombo to Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Drive to Sigiriya (4 hrs). Afternoon climb Sigiriya Rock Fortress - UNESCO World Heritage Site with stunning frescoes.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya to Kandy
itinerary.description: Morning Dambulla Cave Temple visit. Drive to Kandy. Visit Temple of the Tooth Relic. Evening Kandyan dance show.

itinerary.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Morning Peradeniya Botanical Gardens. Drive to Nuwara Eliya via scenic tea plantations. Tea factory tour and tasting.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya to Bentota
itinerary.description: Morning at Nuwara Eliya (Little England). Drive to Bentota. Afternoon beach relaxation. Optional water sports.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Galle Fort. Drive to Colombo airport for departure.

packages.name: Bali Romantic Getaway
packages.description: A romantic escape to Bali with private pool villas, sunset temple visits, rice terrace walks, and couples spa. The Island of the Gods sets the stage for love.
included: Uluwatu Temple tour with Kecak dance
Tegallalang Rice Terrace & Tirta Empul tour

itinerary.title: Welcome to Bali
itinerary.description: Arrive at Ngurah Rai Airport. Welcome with flower garlands. Transfer to private pool villa in Seminyak.

itinerary.title: Ubud Cultural Day
itinerary.description: Drive to Ubud. Visit Tegallalang Rice Terraces, Tirta Empul water temple, and Ubud Monkey Forest. Afternoon couples spa.

itinerary.title: Temples & Sunsets
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Tanah Lot sea temple. Afternoon Uluwatu Temple. Sunset Kecak dance performance. Seafood dinner at Jimbaran Bay.

itinerary.title: Adventure Day
itinerary.description: Early morning Mount Batur sunrise trek (optional). Afternoon Seminyak beach club relaxation and sunset cocktails.

itinerary.title: Bali at Leisure
itinerary.description: Full day at leisure. Optional: cooking class, snorkeling, or Nusa Penida day trip. Farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure. Transfer to airport.

packages.name: Malaysia & Singapore Combo
packages.description: The best of two amazing countries! Explore Kuala Lumpur's Petronas Towers, Genting Highlands, and then Singapore's iconic attractions. Double the fun!

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kuala Lumpur
itinerary.description: Arrive at KLIA. Transfer to hotel. Evening Petronas Twin Towers visit and KLCC Park fountain show.

itinerary.title: KL City Tour
itinerary.description: Morning city tour - Independence Square, National Mosque, Istana Negara, and Batu Caves. Evening at Bukit Bintang.

itinerary.title: Genting Highlands
itinerary.description: Full day Genting Highlands. Cable car ride, theme park, and casino. Cool mountain escape from the city.

itinerary.title: KL to Singapore
itinerary.description: Fly to Singapore. Check-in to hotel. Evening Clarke Quay riverside dining and nightlife.

itinerary.title: Singapore - Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Full day Universal Studios Singapore. Movie-themed rides, shows, and attractions.

itinerary.title: Singapore Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Gardens by the Bay, Sentosa Island, and Chinatown food trail. Evening Marina Bay Sands area.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at Orchard Road for shopping. Transfer to Changi Airport for departure.

packages.name: Singapore Delight
packages.description: Experience the futuristic city of Singapore with Gardens by the Bay, Universal Studios, Sentosa Island, and the iconic Marina Bay Sands. A perfect family destination.
highlights: Gardens by the Bay light show

itinerary.title: Arrival in Singapore
itinerary.description: Arrive at Changi Airport. Transfer to hotel. Evening Gardens by the Bay light show and Marina Bay Sands area.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios
itinerary.description: Full day at Universal Studios Singapore. Thrilling rides, shows, and character meet-and-greets.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island
itinerary.description: Full day Sentosa Island - S.E.A. Aquarium, Adventure Cove Waterpark, and Skyline Luge. Evening Wings of Time show.

itinerary.title: City Tour & Night Safari
itinerary.description: Morning city tour - Merlion Park, Chinatown, Little India. Afternoon at leisure. Evening Night Safari.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning shopping at Orchard Road. Transfer to Changi Airport for departure.

packages.name: Thailand Explorer
packages.description: Explore the best of Thailand from Bangkok's vibrant streets to Phuket's stunning beaches. Temples, street food, island hopping, and nightlife — Thailand has it all!
included: Phi Phi Island tour by speedboat

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok
itinerary.description: Arrive at Suvarnabhumi Airport. Transfer to hotel. Evening street food tour on Yaowarat Road (Chinatown).

itinerary.title: Bangkok Temples & Markets
itinerary.description: Morning Grand Palace, Emerald Buddha, and Wat Pho. Afternoon floating market visit. Evening Asiatique night market.

itinerary.title: Bangkok to Phuket
itinerary.description: Fly to Phuket. Check-in to hotel. Afternoon Patong Beach. Evening Bangla Road nightlife experience.

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Islands
itinerary.description: Full day Phi Phi Islands tour by speedboat. Maya Bay, Pileh Lagoon, Monkey Beach, and snorkeling. Lunch on the island.

itinerary.title: Phuket at Leisure
itinerary.description: Day at leisure. Optional: James Bond Island tour, Thai cooking class, or spa and wellness day.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure. Transfer to Phuket airport for departure.

packages.name: Maldives Paradise Escape
packages.description: The ultimate tropical paradise experience with overwater villa, crystal-clear lagoon, underwater restaurant, and sunset dolphin cruise. A once-in-a-lifetime luxury escape.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Paradise
itinerary.description: Arrive at Malé. Speedboat transfer to resort. Welcome champagne. Check-in to overwater villa. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Ocean Adventures
itinerary.description: Morning guided snorkeling excursion to coral reef. Afternoon overwater spa treatment. Evening sunset dolphin cruise.

itinerary.title: Luxury & Indulgence
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure. Afternoon underwater restaurant dining experience. Evening private beach dinner under the stars.

itinerary.title: Island Exploration
itinerary.description: Morning local island visit. Afternoon water sports - kayaking, paddle boarding. Farewell dinner at resort.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure. Speedboat transfer to Malé airport.

packages.name: Dubai Honeymoon Special
packages.description: A romantic honeymoon in Dubai with luxury stays, private desert dinner, couples spa, and unforgettable skyline views. The perfect blend of romance and luxury.
highlights: Luxury suite with Burj Khalifa view

itinerary.title: Welcome to Dubai
itinerary.description: Arrive at Dubai. Private transfer to luxury hotel. Room with Burj Khalifa view. Evening romantic dinner at hotel.

itinerary.title: Dubai Romance & Burj Khalifa
itinerary.description: Morning Burj Khalifa VIP experience. Afternoon couples spa. Evening dinner at Atmosphere (Level 122).

itinerary.title: Desert Romance
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure. Afternoon private desert setup with dinner under the stars, campfire, and stargazing.

itinerary.title: Yacht & Beach
itinerary.description: Morning beach club access. Afternoon private yacht cruise along Dubai Marina at sunset. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Shopping & Farewell
itinerary.description: Morning shopping at Dubai Mall. Afternoon at leisure. Farewell dinner at Pierchic (overwater restaurant).

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure. Private transfer to airport.

packages.name: Dubai Luxury Experience
packages.description: Experience the glitz and glamour of Dubai with Burj Khalifa, desert safari, dhow cruise, and world-class shopping. A luxurious getaway in the city of gold.
included: Desert safari with BBQ dinner & belly dance

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai
itinerary.description: Arrive at Dubai airport. Transfer to 5-star hotel. Evening Dhow Cruise on Dubai Creek with dinner and entertainment.

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour & Burj Khalifa
itinerary.description: Morning Dubai city tour - Jumeirah Mosque, Dubai Frame, Palm Jumeirah. Afternoon Burj Khalifa visit. Evening Dubai Fountain Show.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Morning at Dubai Mall & Aquarium. Afternoon at leisure. Evening desert safari with dune bashing, camel ride, BBQ dinner, and belly dance.

itinerary.title: Shopping & Leisure
itinerary.description: Morning Gold Souk and Spice Souk visit. Afternoon at leisure for shopping at Mall of Emirates or Ibn Battuta. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure. Check-out and transfer to Dubai airport.

packages.name: Dharamshala & McLeod Ganj
packages.description: Experience the serene beauty of Dharamshala and McLeod Ganj with Tibetan culture, stunning mountain views, and peaceful monasteries. A perfect mountain retreat.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dharamshala
itinerary.description: Arrive at Pathankot/Kangra. Drive to Dharamshala. Evening visit to Dalai Lama Temple Complex and McLeod Ganj market.

itinerary.title: McLeod Ganj & Tibetan Culture
itinerary.description: Visit Norbulingka Institute, Gyuto Monastery, and St. John in the Wilderness. Afternoon Tibetan cooking class.

itinerary.title: Triund Trek
itinerary.description: Moderate trek to Triund (9 km). Stunning views of Dhauladhar range. Packed lunch at the top. Return by evening.

itinerary.title: Dharamshala Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Dharamshala Cricket Stadium, Bhagsunag Temple & Waterfall, and Kangra Fort. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure. Transfer to Pathankot/Kangra for departure.

packages.name: Himachal Himalayan Journey
packages.description: A complete Himachal Pradesh experience covering Shimla, Manali, and Dharamshala. From colonial charm to adventure sports and Tibetan culture, this trip has it all.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Shimla
itinerary.description: Arrive at Kalka. Board the UNESCO toy train to Shimla. Evening walk on Mall Road and Ridge.

itinerary.title: Shimla Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Jakhu Temple, Christ Church, State Museum, and Indian Institute of Advanced Studies. Evening at Lakkar Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Shimla to Manali
itinerary.description: Scenic drive from Shimla to Manali (7-8 hrs) via Kullu. En route visit Pandoh Dam and Kullu shawl factories.

itinerary.title: Manali - Solang Valley
itinerary.description: Full day at Solang Valley for adventure activities - paragliding, zorbing, rope way, and ATV rides.

itinerary.title: Manali to Dharamshala
itinerary.description: Drive to Dharamshala (6-7 hrs). Evening visit to Dalai Lama Temple Complex in McLeod Ganj.

itinerary.title: Dharamshala Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit Bhagsunag Temple & Waterfall, Dharamshala Cricket Stadium, Norbulingka Institute, and St. John Church.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure. Drive to Pathankot/Kangra airport for departure.

packages.name: Sikkim Serenity Tour
packages.description: Discover the mystical beauty of Sikkim with its ancient monasteries, pristine lakes, and panoramic mountain views. A journey of peace and natural wonder.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Gangtok
itinerary.description: Arrive at Bagdogra/NJP. Drive to Gangtok (4 hrs). Evening stroll on MG Marg.

itinerary.title: Gangtok - Tsomgo Lake & Nathula
itinerary.description: Excursion to Tsomgo Lake, Baba Mandir, and Nathula Pass (subject to permit). Return to Gangtok by evening.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Monastery Trail
itinerary.description: Visit Rumtek Monastery, Do Drul Chorten, Institute of Tibetology, and Enchey Monastery. Afternoon at MG Marg.

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Pelling
itinerary.description: Drive to Pelling via Ravangla (Buddha Park). Afternoon visit to Pelling Skywalk and Rimbi Waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Pelling Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Khecheopalri Lake, Kanchenjunga Falls, and Rabdentse Ruins. Stunning views of Kanchenjunga range.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Drive from Pelling to Bagdogra/NJP for departure.

packages.name: Golden Triangle Tour
packages.description: Explore India's most iconic circuit — Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur. Visit the magnificent Taj Mahal, explore majestic forts, and experience the vibrant culture of Rajasthan.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi
itinerary.description: Arrive in Delhi. Afternoon tour of New Delhi - India Gate, Parliament House, Qutub Minar, and Humayun's Tomb.

itinerary.title: Old Delhi Exploration
itinerary.description: Morning Old Delhi tour - Red Fort, Jama Masjid, Raj Ghat. Cycle rickshaw ride through Chandni Chowk. Afternoon drive to Agra.

itinerary.title: Agra - The Taj Mahal
itinerary.description: Sunrise visit to Taj Mahal. After breakfast visit Agra Fort and Itmad-ud-Daulah (Baby Taj). Afternoon drive to Jaipur via Fatehpur Sikri.

itinerary.title: Jaipur - Pink City
itinerary.description: Morning Amber Fort with elephant ride. Afternoon City Palace, Jantar Mantar, and Hawa Mahal. Evening cultural show.

itinerary.title: Jaipur at Leisure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Nahargarh Fort and Sisodia Garden. Afternoon shopping for textiles, jewelry, and handicrafts.

itinerary.title: Return to Delhi
itinerary.description: Drive back to Delhi. Last-minute shopping or sightseeing. Transfer to airport for departure.

packages.name: Manali Honeymoon Retreat
packages.description: A romantic escape to the mountains with cozy resort stays, candlelight dinners, scenic walks, and unforgettable sunsets. The perfect honeymoon in the Himalayas.

itinerary.title: Welcome to the Mountains
itinerary.description: Arrive in Manali. Welcome drink and honeymoon cake. Check-in to riverside resort. Evening romantic walk along Beas River.

itinerary.title: Manali Romance
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Hadimba Temple. Afternoon couples spa. Evening candlelight dinner with mountain views.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley Fun
itinerary.description: Day trip to Solang Valley. Play in snow, rope way ride, and adventure activities together. Evening bonfire.

itinerary.title: Rohtang Pass Excursion
itinerary.description: Day excursion to Rohtang Pass (seasonal). Snow play and photography. Evening at leisure in resort.

itinerary.title: Old Manali & Nature Walk
itinerary.description: Morning nature walk through pine forests. Explore Old Manali cafes and shops. Afternoon at leisure.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning breakfast. Check-out and transfer with beautiful memories.

packages.name: Manali Adventure Package
packages.description: An adventure-packed trip to Manali with paragliding, river rafting, trekking, and skiing (seasonal). Experience the thrill of the Himalayas with stunning valley views.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Manali
itinerary.description: Arrive at Manali. Check-in to resort. Evening visit to Hadimba Temple, Manu Temple, and Old Manali cafe hopping.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley Adventure
itinerary.description: Full day at Solang Valley. Paragliding, zorbing, ATV rides, and rope way. Winter: skiing and snow play.

itinerary.title: Rohtang Pass & Rafting
itinerary.description: Morning excursion to Rohtang Pass (subject to permit/season). Afternoon river rafting on the Beas River.

itinerary.title: Manali Exploration
itinerary.description: Visit Vashisht Hot Springs, Jogini Waterfalls trek, and Tibetan Monastery. Evening bonfire with fellow travelers.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure. Check-out and transfer to bus stand/airport.

packages.name: Andaman Island Escape
packages.description: Escape to the pristine islands of Andaman with crystal-clear waters, vibrant coral reefs, and untouched beaches. Perfect for snorkeling, scuba diving, and tropical relaxation.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Port Blair
itinerary.description: Arrive at Port Blair. Visit Cellular Jail and attend the Light & Sound Show. Evening at Aberdeen Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Port Blair - Ross & North Bay
itinerary.description: Visit Ross Island (by boat). Snorkeling at North Bay Island (Coral Island). Visit Chidiya Tapu in evening.

itinerary.title: Port Blair to Havelock Island
itinerary.description: Ferry to Havelock Island. Visit world-famous Radhanagar Beach for sunset. Overnight at Havelock.

itinerary.title: Havelock - Scuba & Beach
itinerary.description: Morning scuba diving session. Afternoon visit to Elephant Beach for snorkeling and water sports.

itinerary.title: Havelock to Port Blair
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure. Afternoon ferry back to Port Blair. Evening visit to Marina Park and Water Sports Complex.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Anthropological Museum. Transfer to airport for departure.

packages.name: Darjeeling & Sikkim Combo
packages.description: Explore the Queen of Hills and the magical land of Sikkim. Witness sunrise at Tiger Hill, ride the toy train, visit Buddhist monasteries, and enjoy stunning mountain views.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Darjeeling
itinerary.description: Arrive at Bagdogra/NJP. Drive to Darjeeling (3 hrs). Check-in and evening stroll on Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Early morning Tiger Hill sunrise. Visit Ghoom Monastery, Batasia Loop, Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, and Padmaja Naidu Zoo.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling - Toy Train & Tea
itinerary.description: Morning Toy Train Joy Ride. Visit Happy Valley Tea Estate. Afternoon visit to Japanese Temple and Peace Pagoda.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling to Gangtok
itinerary.description: Drive to Gangtok (4 hrs). Afternoon visit to Rumtek Monastery and Do Drul Chorten.

itinerary.title: Gangtok - Tsomgo Lake & Baba Mandir
itinerary.description: Full day excursion to Tsomgo Lake, Baba Mandir, and (subject to permit) Nathula Pass at Indo-China border.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure in Gangtok. Drive to Bagdogra/NJP for departure.

packages.name: Goa Beach Getaway
packages.description: Sun, sand, and party! Experience Goa's best beaches, vibrant nightlife, water sports, Portuguese heritage, and mouthwatering seafood on this unforgettable beach vacation.
highlights: Portuguese heritage walk in Old Goa

itinerary.title: Arrival in Goa
itinerary.description: Arrive at Goa airport/railway station. Transfer to beach resort. Evening at Baga Beach and Tito's Lane for nightlife.

itinerary.title: North Goa Beaches & Forts
itinerary.description: Visit Calangute, Baga, and Anjuna beaches. Fort Aguada and Chapora Fort. Afternoon water sports. Evening casino visit.

itinerary.title: South Goa & Old Goa
itinerary.description: Visit Old Goa churches - Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral. Dona Paula, Miramar Beach. Afternoon spice plantation tour.

itinerary.title: Dolphin Ride & Leisure
itinerary.description: Morning dolphin spotting boat ride. Rest of day at leisure - beach hopping, shopping at flea markets, or spa.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure. Check-out and transfer to airport/railway station.

packages.name: Kashmir Honeymoon Delight
packages.description: A dreamy honeymoon in paradise with luxury houseboat stays, romantic shikara rides, candlelight dinners, and the stunning backdrop of the Himalayas.
included: 6 nights accommodation in premium hotels & houseboat

itinerary.title: Arrival - Welcome to Paradise
itinerary.description: Arrive at Srinagar. Welcome with flowers and Kahwa. Transfer to luxury houseboat. Romantic shikara ride at sunset.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Romance
itinerary.description: Visit Mughal Gardens. Afternoon romantic walk by Dal Lake. Evening candlelight dinner on the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg
itinerary.description: Drive to Gulmarg. Gondola ride to snow point. Play in the snow together. Evening bonfire at resort.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg at Leisure
itinerary.description: Full day at leisure in Gulmarg. Optional ATV rides, horse riding, or simply enjoy the meadows together.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg to Pahalgam
itinerary.description: Drive to Pahalgam. Visit Betaab Valley and Aru Valley. Evening riverside walk along the Lidder.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam - Valley of Love
itinerary.description: Couples trek to Baisaran meadows. Afternoon at leisure. Farewell Wazwan dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Drive to Srinagar airport. Last-minute shopping for pashmina and saffron.

packages.name: Kashmir Valley Explorer
packages.description: Discover the breathtaking beauty of Kashmir with stays in Srinagar, Gulmarg, and Pahalgam. Experience shikara rides, gondola cable car, and the stunning Mughal Gardens.
included: All transfers by non-AC vehicle (hill terrain)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar
itinerary.description: Arrive at Srinagar airport. Transfer to houseboat on Dal Lake. Evening shikara ride witnessing the floating gardens and sunset.

itinerary.title: Srinagar - Mughal Gardens
itinerary.description: Visit the famous Mughal Gardens - Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, and Chashme Shahi. Afternoon visit to local handicraft emporium.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg
itinerary.description: Drive to Gulmarg (2.5 hrs). Gondola cable car ride to Apharwat peak. Evening at leisure in the meadow of flowers.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg to Pahalgam
itinerary.description: Drive to Pahalgam (4 hrs). En route visit saffron fields and Awantipura ruins. Afternoon visit to Betaab Valley and Aru Valley.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Full day at Pahalgam. Visit Chandanwari, Baisaran meadows, and Lidder River. Optional pony rides available.

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.description: Drive back to Srinagar airport for departure. Shopping for Kashmiri handicrafts if time permits.

packages.name: Kerala Honeymoon Special
packages.description: A romantic getaway through Kerala's most enchanting destinations. Private houseboat stays, candlelight dinners, and couples spa treatments make this the perfect honeymoon.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi - Transfer to Munnar
itinerary.description: Welcome at Kochi airport with flower garlands. Scenic drive to Munnar. Check-in to romantic resort. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Munnar Romance & Tea Gardens
itinerary.description: Morning tea plantation walk. Visit Eravikulam National Park. Afternoon couples spa. Evening candlelight dinner at resort.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Alleppey Houseboat
itinerary.description: Drive to Alleppey. Board private houseboat with flower decoration. Cruise through backwaters. Candlelight dinner on houseboat.

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Kovalam
itinerary.description: Disembark houseboat. Drive to Kovalam beach. Afternoon relaxation at beach. Romantic sunset view from lighthouse beach.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Morning beach walk. Breakfast at hotel. Transfer to Trivandrum/Kochi airport.

packages.name: Kerala Backwaters & Beaches
packages.description: Experience the magical backwaters of Kerala with houseboat stays, visit pristine beaches, explore tea plantations in Munnar, and witness traditional Kathakali performances.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi
itinerary.description: Arrive at Kochi airport. Transfer to hotel. Evening visit to Fort Kochi, Chinese Fishing Nets, and Jew Town.

itinerary.title: Kochi to Munnar
itinerary.description: Drive to Munnar (4 hrs). En route visit Cheeyappara & Valara waterfalls. Afternoon tea plantation visit and Tea Museum.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Full day Munnar sightseeing - Eravikulam National Park, Mattupetty Dam, Echo Point, and Kundala Lake.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady
itinerary.description: Drive to Thekkady (3 hrs). Afternoon Periyar wildlife boat safari and spice plantation tour.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey Houseboat
itinerary.description: Drive to Alleppey. Board traditional houseboat for overnight backwater cruise with all meals onboard.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kochi
itinerary.description: Disembark houseboat. Transfer to Kochi airport for departure.

destinations.name: Vietnam
destinations.description: From the emerald waters of Ha Long Bay to the charming streets of Hoi An, Vietnam captivates with its natural beauty, rich history, and incredible cuisine. An affordable yet unforgettable destination.

destinations.name: Nepal
destinations.description: Home to the Himalayas and Mount Everest, Nepal offers trekking adventures, ancient temples, and warm hospitality. From Kathmandu's cultural heritage to Pokhara's serene lakes, Nepal is a trekker's paradise.

destinations.name: Bali (Indonesia)
destinations.description: The Island of the Gods, Bali mesmerizes with its terraced rice paddies, ancient temples, volcanic hills, and stunning beaches. A spiritual and cultural haven with world-class surfing and wellness retreats.

destinations.name: Sri Lanka
destinations.description: The Pearl of the Indian Ocean, Sri Lanka offers ancient ruins, lush tea plantations, exotic wildlife, and golden beaches. A compact island with incredible diversity from culture to nature.

destinations.name: Malaysia
destinations.description: Truly Asia! Malaysia offers a rich cultural tapestry, from the Petronas Twin Towers to the lush rainforests of Borneo. Enjoy diverse cuisine, stunning islands, and vibrant cities all in one destination.

destinations.name: Thailand
destinations.description: The Land of Smiles offers ornate temples, pristine beaches, vibrant street markets, and world-famous cuisine. From Bangkok's bustling streets to Phuket's serene shores, Thailand has something for everyone.

destinations.name: Singapore
destinations.description: A futuristic city-state, Singapore blends stunning architecture, lush gardens, and a melting pot of cultures. From Marina Bay Sands to Gardens by the Bay, it's a city that never fails to amaze.

destinations.name: Maldives
destinations.description: The ultimate tropical paradise, the Maldives features overwater villas, crystal-clear lagoons, and vibrant coral reefs. A bucket-list destination for honeymooners and luxury seekers with unmatched serenity.

destinations.name: Dubai
destinations.description: A gleaming metropolis of luxury and innovation, Dubai dazzles with its iconic Burj Khalifa, pristine beaches, world-class shopping, and desert safaris. Experience the perfect blend of tradition and modernity.

destinations.name: Himachal Pradesh
destinations.description: From the colonial charm of Shimla to the adventure capital of Manali, Himachal Pradesh is a land of diverse landscapes. Snow-capped peaks, lush valleys, apple orchards, and warm hospitality await you.

destinations.name: Sikkim
destinations.description: A small but stunning state in northeast India, Sikkim offers breathtaking views of Kanchenjunga, ancient Buddhist monasteries, pristine lakes, and vibrant rhododendron forests. A perfect blend of nature and spirituality.

destinations.name: Dharamshala
destinations.description: Nestled in the Kangra Valley, Dharamshala is a serene hill station with Tibetan culture, stunning mountain views, and the famous cricket stadium. McLeod Ganj, its upper suburb, offers a unique cultural experience.

destinations.name: Delhi - Golden Triangle
destinations.description: The Golden Triangle circuit covers Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur — three cities that showcase India's rich heritage. From the Taj Mahal to the Amber Fort, experience the best of Indian history, culture, and architecture.

destinations.name: Manali
destinations.description: A picturesque hill station nestled in the Beas River Valley, Manali is a haven for adventure enthusiasts and nature lovers. From skiing in Solang Valley to trekking through pine forests, Manali offers thrilling experiences year-round.

destinations.name: Darjeeling
destinations.description: The Queen of Hills, Darjeeling captivates with its tea gardens, the iconic toy train, and stunning views of Kanchenjunga. Sip world-famous tea while watching the sunrise paint the Himalayas in golden hues.

destinations.name: Andaman & Nicobar
destinations.description: A tropical archipelago in the Bay of Bengal, the Andaman Islands boast pristine white-sand beaches, crystal-clear turquoise waters, and vibrant coral reefs. Perfect for snorkeling, scuba diving, and beach lovers.

destinations.name: Goa
destinations.description: India's sunshine state, Goa is famous for its golden beaches, vibrant nightlife, Portuguese heritage, and delicious seafood. From sun-kissed beaches to spice plantations, Goa offers the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure.

destinations.name: Kashmir
destinations.description: Paradise on Earth, Kashmir enchants with its pristine valleys, snow-capped mountains, crystal-clear lakes, and vibrant Mughal gardens. Sail on Dal Lake in a shikara and experience the breathtaking beauty of the Himalayas.

destinations.name: Kerala
destinations.description: Known as "God's Own Country," Kerala is a tropical paradise with serene backwaters, lush hill stations, exotic wildlife, and beautiful beaches. Experience the magic of houseboat stays on tranquil backwaters surrounded by palm trees.

hotels.name: COMO Uma Canggu Bali
hotels.description: A chic beachfront resort in Bali with surf school, holistic wellness programs, and stunning ocean views from every room.

hotels.name: Shangri-La Kuala Lumpur
hotels.description: A premier luxury hotel with stunning Petronas Twin Towers views, award-winning restaurants, and a serene spa in the heart of KL.

hotels.name: Mandarin Oriental Bangkok
hotels.description: A legendary riverside hotel offering timeless elegance, world-class dining, and authentic Thai experiences in the heart of Bangkok.

hotels.name: Marina Bay Sands Singapore
hotels.description: The iconic three-tower hotel with the world-famous infinity pool on the 57th floor, offering breathtaking views of the Singapore skyline.

hotels.name: Atlantis The Palm Dubai
hotels.description: An iconic resort on Palm Jumeirah with Aquaventure Waterpark, private beach, underwater aquarium, and 23 restaurants.

hotels.name: Soneva Fushi Maldives
hotels.description: A barefoot luxury resort with private villa, personal butler, world-class snorkeling, and an observatory for stargazing.

hotels.name: Burj Al Arab Dubai
hotels.description: The world's most luxurious hotel, shaped like a sail on its own island. Offers unparalleled opulence, 9 restaurants, and a private beach.

hotels.name: The Leela Palace Manali
hotels.description: A riverside luxury resort in Manali with stunning mountain views, heated pools, and adventure sports facilities.

hotels.name: The Taj Palace Delhi
hotels.description: An iconic luxury hotel in the heart of New Delhi offering world-class dining, spa, and impeccable service near major attractions.

hotels.name: Wildflower Hall Shimla
hotels.description: A luxury Oberoi resort at 8,250 feet offering panoramic Himalayan views, world-class spa, and colonial elegance in the lap of nature.

hotels.name: Welcomhotel By ITC Bay Island
hotels.description: A beautiful beachfront resort in Port Blair offering stunning ocean views, water sports, and easy access to the best Andaman attractions.

hotels.name: Windamere Hotel Darjeeling
hotels.description: A colonial heritage hotel on Observatory Hill offering old-world charm, roaring fireplaces, and panoramic views of the Himalayas.

hotels.name: Taj Holiday Village Goa
hotels.description: A charming Portuguese-style resort on Sinquerim Beach with lush tropical gardens, multiple pools, and direct beach access.

hotels.name: Houseboat Heavenly Kashmir
hotels.description: Experience authentic Kashmiri hospitality on a luxury houseboat on Dal Lake with carved walnut interiors and traditional Kashmiri cuisine.

hotels.name: The Lalit Grand Palace
hotels.description: A grand palace hotel overlooking Dal Lake with magnificent Mughal-inspired architecture, lush gardens, and world-class hospitality.

hotels.name: Coconut Lagoon Resort
hotels.description: A heritage resort set on the banks of Vembanad Lake, offering authentic Kerala experiences with houseboat stays and traditional cuisine.

hotels.name: Taj Malabar Resort & Spa
hotels.description: A luxury waterfront resort on Willingdon Island offering world-class amenities, Ayurvedic spa, and stunning views of the Kochi harbor.

reviews.title: Manali Adventure Package

reviews.text: Bali exceeded all our expectations! The Tegallalang rice terraces and Uluwatu temple at sunset were magical. The private pool villa was the perfect romantic touch. Will definitely book again!

reviews.name: Deepa Krishnan
reviews.title: Sri Lanka Cultural Trip
reviews.text: Rich cultural experience! Sigiriya rock fortress was awe-inspiring. The tea gardens in Nuwara Eliya were beautiful. The local cuisine was a delightful surprise. Very well-curated itinerary.

reviews.title: Thailand Explorer
reviews.text: Thailand was amazing! From the temples in Bangkok to the beaches in Phuket, every day was an adventure. The street food tour was a fantastic addition. Wayfare planned everything flawlessly.

reviews.title: Andaman Island Escape

reviews.title: Maldives Paradise Escape

blogs.title: Ladakh Bike Trip: Everything You Need to Know
blogs.excerpt: The ultimate guide to planning your dream Ladakh bike trip — routes, permits, packing list, budget, and insider tips from experienced riders.
blogs.content:
The Call of the Mountains

A Ladakh bike trip is a bucket-list adventure for every rider in India. The journey through the world's highest motorable passes, across vast barren landscapes and beside pristine lakes, is an experience like no other.

When to Go

  • Mid-June to Mid-September: The only reliable window
  • Best Month: July offers the best weather and road conditions
  • Avoid: October onwards — unpredictable weather and road closures

Popular Routes

Route 1: Srinagar-Leh Highway (425 km)

The gentler approach. This route gradually gains altitude, helping with acclimatization.

Route 2: Manali-Leh Highway (473 km)

The more dramatic and challenging route. Higher passes, stunning landscapes.

Budget Breakdown (Per Person)

  • Bike rental (12 days): ₹18,000-₹24,000
  • Fuel (2,500 km approx): ₹8,000-₹10,000
  • Accommodation (12 nights): ₹9,000-₹18,000
  • Food (12 days): ₹8,000-₹12,000
  • Permits & entry fees: ₹1,500-₹2,000
  • Miscellaneous: ₹3,000-₹5,000
  • Total: ₹47,500-₹71,000 per person

Pro Tips

  • Acclimatize for 2 days in Leh before riding to high passes
  • Start early — weather changes rapidly in the afternoon
  • Ride in a group of 4-6 bikes for safety
  • Stay hydrated — the dry mountain air dehydrates you faster than you realize
blogs.authorBio: Adventure motorcyclist who has completed 6 Ladakh expeditions. Founder of the Delhi Riders motorcycle club.

blogs.title: Maldives vs Bali: Which is Better for Your Honeymoon?
blogs.excerpt: Torn between the overwater villas of Maldives and the cultural charm of Bali? Our detailed comparison helps you decide the perfect honeymoon destination.
blogs.content:
The Great Honeymoon Debate

Maldives and Bali are two of the most popular honeymoon destinations for Indian couples. Both offer stunning natural beauty and romantic experiences, but they're completely different in character.

Budget Comparison

Maldives (5 nights):

  • Budget: ₹80,000-₹1,20,000 per couple
  • Mid-range: ₹1,50,000-₹2,50,000 per couple
  • Luxury: ₹3,00,000+ per couple

Bali (5 nights):

  • Budget: ₹50,000-₹80,000 per couple
  • Mid-range: ₹1,00,000-₹1,80,000 per couple
  • Luxury: ₹2,00,000+ per couple

Activities & Experiences

Maldives: Snorkeling with manta rays, private sandbank dining, underwater restaurants, sunset dolphin cruises

Bali: Tegallalang Rice Terrace, Uluwatu Temple sunset, Mount Batur sunrise trek, Seminyak beach clubs, cooking classes

The Verdict

Choose Maldives if: You want pure relaxation, luxury, and privacy.

Choose Bali if: You want a mix of adventure, culture, and relaxation.
blogs.authorBio: Luxury travel consultant specializing in honeymoon planning. Has planned 500+ honeymoons across Asia and the Indian Ocean.

blogs.title: Dubai on a Budget: Tips for Indian Travelers
blogs.excerpt: Think Dubai is only for the rich? Think again! Our insider guide shows you how to experience the best of Dubai without burning a hole in your pocket.
blogs.content:
Dubai Doesn't Have to Break the Bank

Dubai has a reputation for luxury, but it's surprisingly accessible for budget-conscious Indian travelers. With smart planning, you can experience the best of this glittering city for under ₹50,000 for a 4-night trip (including flights!).

Getting Cheap Flights to Dubai

  • Budget Airlines: Flydubai, Air India Express, SpiceJet offer direct flights starting at ₹8,000-₹12,000 round trip
  • Off-Peak Travel: February-May and September-November offer the best deals
  • Mid-Week Flights: Tuesday and Wednesday departures are typically 20-30% cheaper

Free Things to Do in Dubai

  • Dubai Fountain Show: The world's largest choreographed fountain — absolutely free
  • Dubai Marina Walk: Stunning waterfront promenade
  • Kite Beach: Beautiful public beach with Burj Al Arab views
  • Dubai Creek Abra Ride: Traditional boat ride for just AED 1

Sample 4-Night Budget Breakdown

  • Flights (round trip): ₹10,000-₹15,000
  • Accommodation (4 nights): ₹10,000-₹16,000
  • Food (4 days): ₹6,000-₹8,000
  • Activities: ₹8,000-₹12,000
  • Transport: ₹3,000-₹4,000
  • Visa: ₹5,500-₹6,500
  • Total: ₹42,500-₹61,500 per person
blogs.authorBio: Travel hacker and budget travel expert who has visited 25+ countries on a shoestring budget.

blogs.title: Complete Kerala Travel Guide: Backwaters, Hills & Beaches
blogs.excerpt: Your ultimate guide to exploring God's Own Country — from Alleppey houseboats to Munnar tea estates, discover the best of Kerala.
blogs.content:
Welcome to Kerala

Kerala, known as "God's Own Country," is a narrow strip of land along India's southwestern coast that packs an extraordinary diversity of landscapes into a small area. From the misty Western Ghats to the tranquil Arabian Sea coast, Kerala offers backwaters, hill stations, beaches, wildlife sanctuaries, and a rich cultural heritage.

Best Time to Visit Kerala

The ideal time to visit Kerala is from September to March when the weather is pleasant and dry. The monsoon season (June-August) has its own charm with lush greenery and Ayurvedic wellness season.

Top Destinations in Kerala

Alleppey (Alappuzha) — The Venice of the East

No Kerala trip is complete without a houseboat cruise through Alleppey's backwaters. These traditional kettuvallams have been converted into floating luxury hotels.

Munnar — Tea Garden Paradise

Munnar's rolling hills covered in tea plantations are among the most photographed landscapes in India.

Suggested 7-Day Kerala Itinerary

  1. Day 1-2: Arrive in Kochi, explore Fort Kochi, watch a Kathakali show
  2. Day 3-4: Drive to Munnar, visit tea gardens and Eravikulam National Park
  3. Day 5: Drive to Thekkady, spice plantation tour and Periyar boat safari
  4. Day 6: Drive to Alleppey, board houseboat for overnight backwater cruise
  5. Day 7: Disembark, drive to Kovalam or Kochi airport for departure
blogs.authorBio: Kerala native and travel photographer who has documented every corner of God's Own Country over the past decade.

blogs.title: 10 Best Honeymoon Destinations in India for 2025
blogs.excerpt: From the backwaters of Kerala to the snowy valleys of Kashmir, discover the most romantic destinations in India for your perfect honeymoon getaway.
blogs.content:
Why India is Perfect for Honeymoons

India offers an incredible diversity of honeymoon experiences — from serene backwaters and misty hill stations to golden beaches and royal palaces. Whether you want adventure, relaxation, or cultural immersion, there's a perfect destination waiting for you.

1. Kerala — The God's Own Country

Kerala remains the undisputed king of honeymoon destinations in India. Imagine cruising through tranquil backwaters on a traditional houseboat, watching palm-fringed shores glide by as you sip tender coconut water. Munnar's rolling tea plantations, Alleppey's backwater cruises, and Kovalam's pristine beaches create the perfect romantic trifecta.

Best Time: September to March | Budget: ₹15,000–₹30,000 per person for 5 nights

2. Kashmir — Paradise on Earth

If your idea of romance involves snow-capped mountains, pristine lakes, and Mughal gardens, Kashmir is your dream destination. A shikara ride on Dal Lake at sunset, a stay in a luxurious houseboat, and a drive through the breathtaking Srinagar-Leh highway — every moment is picture-perfect.

Best Time: April to October | Budget: ₹18,000–₹35,000 per person for 5 nights

3. Goa — Beach Romance

Goa needs no introduction. Sun-kissed beaches, vibrant nightlife, Portuguese architecture, and some of the best seafood in the country. Whether you prefer the lively North Goa beaches or the serene South Goa stretches, a Goan honeymoon is always unforgettable.

Best Time: November to February | Budget: ₹12,000–₹25,000 per person for 4 nights

Tips for Planning Your Honeymoon

  • Book at least 2-3 months in advance for the best hotel deals
  • Consider off-season travel for lower prices and fewer crowds
  • Always check weather conditions before finalizing dates
  • Look for honeymoon packages that include special experiences
  • Don't forget travel insurance for international destinations
blogs.authorBio: Travel writer and honeymoon specialist with 8+ years of experience exploring romantic destinations across India and Southeast Asia.
